in_sanskrit.name: Bheem
in_sanskrit.meaning: The Roaring One, The Terror, The Terrible One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Bheem is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhima', which means 'roaring', 'terrifying', or 'terrible'. In Hindu mythology, Bheem is the second of the five Pandava brothers and is known for his immense strength and courage. He is also known as Bhima-Vibhishana, meaning 'the one who vanquishes the fearsome one'.

in_hindi.name: भीम
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Bhīm is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhima', which means 'roaring' or 'terrifying'. The Hindi name Bhīmātmā means 'the one with a fearless and mighty soul'. In Hindu mythology, Bhīm is the second of the five Pandava brothers and is known for his immense strength and courage.

in_tamil.name: பீமம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Pee-maan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhima', which means 'great' or 'mighty'. The Tamil name Pee-maan means 'the great one' or 'the mighty one'.

in_telugu.name: భీమ
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Bheemeesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhima', which means 'roaring' or 'terrifying'. The Telugu name Bheemeesh means 'the god of strength' or 'the mighty one'.
